takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals raised large rounds in 2025 (Prophet 30M Series A, July 2025, per search summary); no acquisition of Cotool found.

brand_strength.rationale: Shortened compound name with no brand coverage found; strength rests on investors and customer logos instead.

outcome_analysis: Cotool is founded by three Material Security alumni and raised a 7.4M seed led by a16z in March 2026, with Ramp and EliseAI named as users. It operates in a crowded AI SOC market, so its outcome depends on keeping agent quality ahead of well funded rivals.
